coverage.summary: Applies only to rental buildings being converted to condominium, cooperative or fee-simple ownership of units. Qualifying senior, disabled or disabled-veteran tenants may obtain protected tenancy. The bar on rent increases to cover conversion costs applies to all tenants in a converting building.
coverage.other_conditions: Triggered only by conversion of the building to condominium, cooperative or fee-simple ownership of units. Protected tenancy is limited to tenants who are 62 or older before the conversion recording date, permanently disabled, or disabled veterans rated 60% or higher. They must have lived in the building at least one year before the recording date and must meet a family income test. The conversion-cost rent bar covers all tenants in the building, whether or not they are eligible for protected tenancy.

result.notes: requires_unknown_facts is kept true. The rule applies only to buildings undergoing conversion to condominium, cooperative or fee-simple ownership, which assessor data cannot identify. Tenant age, disability, veteran status, residency and income criteria were removed from unverifiable_exemptions. They are eligibility conditions for protected tenancy, not exemptions of buildings, units or owners, so they now appear in other_conditions. No unit-count, construction-date or owner-occupancy limits are stated in the source.
